hook_line: EDMONTON'S SNEHA JOY WINS $5 MILLION LOTTO 6/49 JACKPOT

hook_stat.sub: Lotto 6/49 Classic draw jackpot won by Edmonton's Sneha Joy

stats.label: Date of the Lotto 6/49 Classic draw Joy won

diaspora_bullets: Joy bought the winning ticket through the Lotto Spot app and plays regularly
She plans to pay off her mortgage, travel around the world and share the winnings with family
news_summary: Edmonton's Sneha Joy matched all six numbers in the October 21 Lotto 6/49 Classic draw to win $5 million, the Western Canada Lottery Corporation announced this week.
payoff: Joy said the best part of winning is being financially stress-free.
